# MIT PCL formulation dataset

Source: Jurgis Ruza and Michael Stolberg, *Experimental data for
"Autonomous Discovery of Polymer Electrolyte Formulations with Warm-start
Batch Bayesian Optimization"*, Zenodo, 2025,
<https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16741235>.

License: CC BY 4.0. The included CSV is the unmodified file
`supplemental_data_all_experiments.csv` from record 16741235. Its SHA-256 is
`94e80bdcc2386cd6412618c4bd7857afbfdf37094dc9fa232d321d6401a0b936`.

This dataset contains one polymer chemistry (PCL), one molecular weight
(80,000 g/mol), 17 salts, multiple molalities, and measurements near 30, 50,
70, and 90 °C. It cannot identify repeat-unit, molecular-weight, degree-of-
polymerization, architecture, or plasticizer effects.
